contexts.text: They found a valley in the land of Shinar () = that their worship became more impure and profane... A valley = what is lower than the mountains; thus what is lower, or exterior, in worship. Explained.
In the Original, valleys are designated by certain names, by which are signified, when mentioned in this sense, things less or more profane in worship. Illustrated.
The valley of vision () = phantasies and reasonings whereby worship is falsified and at last profaned.
The valley of Hinnom = Hell, and also the profanation of truth and good. AE 659:25.
A valley = worship in externals. Illustrated.

But when the worship has not yet become so profane, it is expressed by the word for valley in , where it treats of those who are in ignorance... and yet are in charity; valley, here, stands for them; and in like manner in .
At the valley of Siddim () = in the unclean things of cupidities. Explained. AC 1688.

At the valley of Shaveh; this is the king's valley () = the state of the External Man as to good and truth at that time... The valley of Shaveh = the goods of the External Man; and the valley of the king = the truths of the same. The external man is called a valley, from the fact that it is below; for that which is exterior is also lower.

(Isaac) encamped in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there () = that He betook Himself to lower rational things, that is, from interior appearances to exterior ones... For a valley = lower, or, what is the same, exterior things.
To dig in the valley () = to seek lower down according to truths as to where they are; for... a valley = what is lower.
Every valley shall be filled (). A valley = what is lowly.
He sent him out of the vale of Hebron () = from the Divine Natural and Sensuous; for a valley = the things which are below.
That a valley = the lower things of the Church. Illustrated.
The valley of vision () = phantasies about spiritual things from sensuous ones: thus from lower things.
The choice of the valleys () = goods and truths in the natural or external man.
Every valley shall be exalted (): valley = lowly things. AE 405:36, Explained.
See thy way in the valley (): valley = scientific and sensuous things, which are lower things through which they pervert truths.
The inhabitress of the valley () = faith in which is not charity.
Thou shalt not glory in the valleys; thy valley hath flowed away, perverse daughter (): valley = the external things in worship, which are also the lowest things.
The valley of shadow () slower things, which are relatively in shade.

As the valleys were between the mountains and hills, and under them, by valleys are signified the lower or exterior things of the Church, because by hills and mountains were signified its higher or interior things... and, as by the Land of Canaan is signified the Lord's Kingdom and His Church, it is said, land of mountains and valleys, that drinketh the waters of the rain of heaven ().

The reason Joseph is said to have been sent from the valley of Hebron, comes from his having been sent to those who were teaching about faith; for those who are in faith and not in charity are in lower things...
In the valley under his feet () = to serve in the lowest things.
A barren valley which is neither cultivated nor sown () = the natural mind not cultivated, in consequence of ignorance, with the truths and goods of faith.
That a valley = the lower mind, which is called the natural mind. References.
The cleaving of the mountain towards the east and towards the sea, in a great valley () = the separation of Heaven and Hell.
In the valleys (in the Spiritual World) are those who have not as yet been carried up to the good of love and of faith... thus to Heaven.
The valley of Achor () = the external (where is celestial good).
The World of Spirits appears like a valley between mountains and rocks, which here and there winds up among them. HH 583.
Mountains, hills, and valleys = the higher, lower, and lowest things of the Church.
(When in the first state of regeneration) they have appeared to me turned to the valleys which are over Hell...
The Angels of the Ultimate Heaven dwell in the valleys between the hills and mountains. AE 304:2.
Between (the distant mountain) and the hill on which we stood, there was a valley, and a plain beyond it.
The land sloped down into a valley, where there were cities...
At last (after a long descent) we came into a valley which was inhabited by (those of the Age of Iron mingled with Clay).
They said that (in that Earth) there are no pleasant places except those of the valleys.
I was brought back, by a great descent, into the valley where I was before...
I saw the whole northern valley... upturned from the bottom...
Watercourses and valleys () = the truths and goods which are the ultimates of the Church.
Exterior truths are said to spring out of the valley () because a valley = the lower and exterior things, where such truths are.
The head of the valley of the fat ones () = the intelligence of the natural man.

The mountains ascend, and the valleys descend to the place which Thou hast founded for them () = that in place of natural loves and the evils from them there are inserted celestial loves and the goods from them; and in place of falsities general truths are admitted.
Between the mountains = truths from goods; for the valleys which are between the mountains = lower truths, which are the truths of the natural man.

Then shall ye flee through the valley of My mountains () = that then those who are in truths from good will be rescued... The valley of the mountains = where those are who are in the Knowledges of truth, and thence in truths from good; for those dwell in the valleys who are in the Knowledges of truth.
Channels and valleys () = exterior or natural things.
Valleys () = the derivative falsities.
The valley of vision = falsity of doctrine confirmed by the sense of the letter...
The inhabitress of the valley... = those in the ultimates of the Word who do not permit themselves to be enlightened...
In the midst of the valleys () = in the exterior man. AE 518:5.
As the valleys are they planted ()... = the intelligence of the natural man; whereas gardens = the intelligence of the spiritual man.
A land of mountains and valleys () = the higher and lower things of the Church, that is, its internal and external things...
When I walk in the shady valley () = an obscure understanding to which truths do not appear by their light.
Fountains in the midst of the valleys () = intelligence from natural truths.
The valleys are covered over with corn () = the natural mind receiving natural truth.
